# PLANARIA

> Progressive Holographic Executable Architecture (`.hbin`), Plang Compiler, PVM-32 Vascular Anastomosis VM, 4-Qubit Temporal-Quantum WebGL2 Studio, Clean-Room Python 3 Differential Oracle, Interactive Proof Blueprint, and 6-Kernel Pure Lean 4.35.0 Formal Verification Suite (`v2.4.0`).

## Core Documentation

- [README](README.md): Overview, quickstart, 5-second verbatim Lean `#print axioms` audit, architecture, and live Studio guide
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): Canonical instructions, one-word commands, hard rules R1–R8, and known pitfalls
- [CLAIMS](CLAIMS.md): Numbered falsifiable claims ledger (`C01`–`C10`) with exact evidence paths and refutation criteria
- [LIMITATIONS](LIMITATIONS.md): Explicit system boundaries, real-vs-metaphor separation, storage ratios, threats to validity, and open dilemmas
- [REPLICATION](REPLICATION.md): Step-by-step clean-clone reproduction protocol and independent replication log
- [VERIFICATION](VERIFICATION.md): 30-suite harness, 12/12 mutation testing, 2,000-case fuzzer, Python 3 oracle, and 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 verification guide
- [SUMMARY](SUMMARY.md): Executive technical summary of PLANARIA v2.4.0
- [INDEX](INDEX.md): Complete repository index and table of contents
